# ZoomGuru

> ZoomGuru is an AI interview copilot desktop app for Windows. It runs as
> an invisible overlay during video interviews (Zoom, Google Meet,
> Microsoft Teams), listens to interviewer questions, and streams coached
> answers in under two seconds. It also includes an AI mock interviewer,
> answer scoring with reports, a document copilot, and screenshot
> walk-throughs for technical problems. Pricing starts at NGN 15,000
> per week, with monthly (NGN 45,000) and yearly (NGN 450,000) plans.
> Payments via Paystack in NGN. A free 30-minute trial is
> available with no card required.

Key facts:
- The overlay is not visible to interviewers during screen share.
- Responses begin streaming in under two seconds.
- Sessions are held in memory only: no transcripts stored, no user data
  used for model training.
- Windows 10/11 (64-bit) supported today; macOS is in development.
